summary: The fault snapshot keeps each operational failure's answer and reads it again only when something it read changed, its time comes, or it rests on a read the change feed does not carry; a full reading every five minutes (every half hour after a day with no correction) counts any difference as a correction

schema.detail: No schema change. The cache is in memory and starts empty at each daemon start.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Faults, owners and order are unchanged; a missing read key shows as a fault-snapshot correction in doctor --performance and is answered correctly by the next full reading, at most five minutes (half an hour on a host quiet for a day) later.

downtime.detail: No startup work; the first snapshot after a start reads every failure, as before.

recovery.detail: An older build reads every failure at every snapshot.
